entries_new.story: Mangrol was a princely state of Kathiawar, in what is now Gujarat, India. Wikipedia's article on Saurashtra names it among the states that were merged into the state of Saurashtra after 1947. Under British paramountcy (overlordship), the rulers of these states largely governed their own lands but could not deal with foreign states or fight other states. The Kathiawar Agency held 193 states in all; the sources read name only a few dozen of them, and give no coordinates for this one.
